protocol.criterion: Match net terminal wealth (equivalently CAGR on identical dates), reject if candidate maximum drawdown magnitude exceeds comparator.
protocol.screening_scope: All applicable primary and full-history assets; any strictly worse drawdown removes the candidate from the research shortlist. Unmatched comparisons are unresolved, not automatic failures. Overlapping cohorts, legacy PE proxies and frequency/cost sensitivity are not additional rejection gates.
protocol.comparator: Monthly fixed target leverage to the same fixed-share buy-and-hold asset/basket; multi-asset relative shares are never equal-weight rebalanced.
protocol.execution_and_drawdown: Same opening quotes and daily closing drawdown as prior main replay; no forced terminal sale.
protocol.root_search: 0x–3x scanned at 0.01x, sign changes bisected 65 times; lowest solvent root retained; no root is unresolved, not an automatic pass. Tangent roots without sign changes could be missed.
protocol.interpretation: Ex-post equal-return diagnostic; not a leverage recommendation or an out-of-sample test.
